title: a-false-statement-in-a-trouble-record-can-be-corrected-in-place
intention: A false statement inside a trouble record can be corrected in place — a correction APPENDED beside it, joined to the exact entry it corrects, so a reader of that record sees both the wrong sentence and what is true. A new door on TroubleDevice, `amend`, alongside raise_trouble and clear: it appends to an `amendments` list and edits nothing. Each amendment carries a join key naming which prior entry it corrects (`{"in": "<list>", "at": "<iso timestamp>"}` — every appended entry in this store already carries an `at`, and no entry has an index that survives a later append), the false statement quoted verbatim, what is true instead, and how that was measured. It does NOT change `standing` and does NOT increment `count`.
why: MEASURED, n=2 in one evening, and the record is on disk: troubles/a-clear-carries-a-false-statement-and-the-lane-has-no-door-to-correct-it.json. Both occurrences are false sentences CC wrote into ONE clear's residue clause — (a) 'run_proof still takes a sink argument and the caller still chooses', falsified six lines below the signature I had grepped; (b) 'that voyage's gate is open; nobody has told it', falsified by a PROVED crossing in a commit Akien authored, in the repo I was committing to. Both landed in the part of a closing record nobody re-measures, because the closing record is the artifact that announces measuring is over — and it is the paragraph the next reader trusts most, being the only forward-looking thing in a record about the past. THE LANE HAD NO WAY TO SAY SO. clear() refuses a second all-clear (rightly — it would overwrite what actually fixed it), raise_trouble on the same identity says a fault RETURNED, and nothing says a sentence was wrong when written. What actually happened is the symptom: a NEW trouble identity was raised to carry the correction, so the correction now lives in a different file from the sentence it corrects, and a reader of the false clear has no route to it. The joining is the whole feature.
traces_to: Law 7 — 'Errors are loud at diagnostic surfaces and permanent in records of truth. A presentation surface may collapse an error into a coherent shape; a record of truth never may.' The trouble store is a record of truth by its own charter (laws.law_7: 'the RECORD is never damped'), and today a false sentence in one is permanent in the wrong direction: it cannot be removed, which is right, and it also cannot be answered, which is not. Also Law 3 — a correction carrying how it was measured is a measurement; one carrying a paragraph is a hypothesis wearing a fix's clothes.

falsifier.proves_green: code-seam invariant: PROVED + feeds-back-to-origin-on-failure (Laws 3 + 8). PROVE GATE: proofs beside cairn/devices/trouble/, run under the tester at isolation=netns, sealed into the component's validations/, driven against a TEMP store root — the proof must not write into CairnCommons/troubles/. FEEDBACK-TO-ORIGIN: the origin is cairn/devices/trouble/intention+why.json, whose `what` will need the amend door named in it; the route back is the trouble lane itself, which is the seam under repair. That circularity is stated rather than hidden — a lane that cannot report its own fault is Law 8's hollow build, and the charter already says so under laws.law_8. ENTRY GATE at BUILDME: chart claim + intent_berth + sorted_berth. EMISSION GATE on WATCHME: the probe armed at its berth or WatchmeEmissionRed. CLEARANCE into PROVED: harbor_master.clearance.clear.
falsifier.proves_red: DONE when a false statement inside a CLEARED trouble is corrected through the lane's own door and a reader of that record sees both sentences joined — proved three ways, and the second is the one that matters: (a) an amendment on a live and on a cleared trouble both land and both resolve their join key; (b) a tooth shows the amend leaves `standing`, `count`, and the corrected entry's TEXT byte-identical — the door cannot erase, which is the property trust cannot substitute for; (c) an amendment whose join key names no existing entry is REFUSED, so the store cannot gain a floating paragraph. WRONG INTENT if amend becomes a way to make a wrong clear look right: a record carrying an amendment must read as MORE marked than one without, never less. Also wrong if it blurs into the re-raise path — a fault that returned is a new ticket at count 1 by the charter's own words, and an amendment must be structurally unable to say that.
falsifier.horizon: One voyage. The store, the append pattern and the in-house precedent all exist; the piece is one method plus its proof on a 311-line module with three write methods today (raise_trouble :131, clear :194, _write :308).
